intro: Jobs similar to firefighters are field and transport roles that rely on teamwork and safety. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Forest and Conservation Workers (77% similar), ambulance drivers and attendants (75%) and forest fire inspectors and prevention specialists (74%).
shared: These careers share physical work, quick decisions and following strict safety procedures as a crew. O*NET rates coordination at 3.88 out of 5 for firefighters, and judgment and service orientation at 3.5. Fire prevention, rail and vessel operation use the same discipline. Only 1 of the 20 is in the firefighting group, and 5 pay more than the $59,280 firefighter median.

faq.q: Which jobs like firefighter pay more?
faq.a: 5 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Water vessel captains, mates and pilots earn $92,460 (56% more), Subway and Streetcar Operators $86,380 (46% more) and Locomotive Engineers $81,410 (37% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Vessel roles need a license.

faq.q: Is fire prevention work similar to firefighting?
faq.a: Yes. Forest fire inspectors and prevention specialists are 74% similar and in the same group. They earn $56,870, which is 4% less than firefighters, and spend more time on inspections, permits and public education than on emergency calls, often with more regular hours.
